posts.title: How Kidney Diseases Behave
posts.description: The kidneys perform several vital functions. First, they remove metabolic waste products from the body. Second, they remove excess water from the body. In addition, the kidneys produce vitamin D and the hormone erythropoietin, which help maintain bone health and haemoglobin levels.
